list.title: Cryptography Project
desc: Experimental cryptography library containing classical ciphers, modern symmetric ciphers, hashing, and asymmetric ciphers.
Doesn't require external dependencies. Uses its own custom arbitrary-precision arithmetic library (big-ar9am).
Written in C and has a Dart binding.
